title: Annual Health Camp 2026
description: Free medical screenings, consultations, and health awareness sessions for families in underserved communities. Includes dental, vision, and general health checkups.

title: Skill Development Workshop — Tailoring
description: A hands-on tailoring workshop for women from underserved backgrounds. Participants will learn basic garment construction and explore livelihood pathways through the skill.

title: Mental Health Awareness Walk
description: Join us for a community walk to raise awareness about mental health, break stigmas, and celebrate the strength of those who seek help.
